description: This file defines types, functions, and logic for generating and handling a plugin SDK API baseline, including source linking, export kind inference, module building, and baseline rendering. It is used for static analysis and documentation generation of plugin API modules.

methods.name: assert
methods.description: Asserts a condition, throws an error with message if false.

methods.name: resolveRepoRoot
methods.description: Resolves the repository root directory based on the current file location.

methods.name: relativePath
methods.description: Converts an absolute file path to a relative path from the repository root.

methods.name: isAbsoluteImportPath
methods.description: Checks if a given import path is absolute.

methods.name: normalizeDeclarationImportSpecifier
methods.description: Normalizes import specifiers to relative paths if possible.

methods.name: normalizeDeclarationText
methods.description: Replaces import paths in declaration text with normalized relative paths.

methods.name: createCompilerContext
methods.description: Creates a TypeScript program, checker, and printer based on tsconfig.json.

methods.name: buildSourceLink
methods.description: Builds a source link object with file path and line number.

methods.name: inferExportKind
methods.description: Infers the export kind (class, enum, function, etc.) from a symbol and declaration.

methods.name: resolveSymbolAndDeclaration
methods.description: Resolves a symbol to its declaration and handles aliasing.

methods.name: printNode
methods.description: Converts a declaration node to a normalized string representation.

methods.name: buildExportSurface
methods.description: Builds export metadata including declaration, name, kind, and source link.

methods.name: sortExports
methods.description: Sorts export objects by kind and name.

methods.name: buildModuleSurface
methods.description: Builds a module surface object with category, entrypoint, exports, import specifier, and source link.

methods.name: buildJsonlLines
methods.description: Converts baseline data into JSONL formatted lines.

methods.name: renderPluginSdkApiBaseline
methods.description: Generates the plugin SDK API baseline, including modules and exports, and returns JSON and JSONL strings.

methods.name: loadCurrentFile
methods.description: Reads a file asynchronously, returns null if not found.

methods.name: sha256
methods.description: Computes SHA-256 hash of a string.

methods.name: computePluginSdkApiBaselineHashFileContent
methods.description: Creates hash file content for the baseline JSON and JSONL artifacts.

methods.name: validateMetadata
methods.description: Validates that all entrypoints in metadata are exported in the plugin SDK.

methods.name: writePluginSdkApiBaselineStatefile
methods.description: Writes the baseline JSON, JSONL, and hash files to disk, optionally checking for changes.
